item.title: Spain closes airspace to US aircraft involved in Iran war
item.summary: It follows a decision by the Spanish government to deny the US use of the two jointly run military bases in Andalusia.

item.title: Palestinians convicted of deadly attacks face death penalty under new Israeli law
item.summary: The new law, passed on Monday, was pushed hard by the far-right and Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir.

item.title: Gazan mother reunited with evacuated daughter after two years
item.summary: The girl is among at least eight children who were premature newborns when they were evacuated during heavy fighting in Gaza at the start of the war.

item.title: Zelensky says allies asked him to scale back attacks on Russian energy
item.summary: Ukraine's president says partners asked if the attacks could be "reduced" as prices soar due to the Iran war.

item.title: Two Indonesian UN peacekeepers killed in explosion in Lebanon
item.summary: It is the second fatal incident in the last 24 hours, Unifil says, after Israel expanded its operation against Hezbollah.

item.title: Latin Patriarch will have access to Jerusalem holy site after police stopped entry
item.summary: The Israeli PM says Cardinal Pierbattista Pizzaballa had been asked not to enter the church over concerns about Iranian strikes.

item.title: 48-hour curfew imposed after attack on bar in Nigerian city
item.summary: The raid led to revenge attacks in Jos, with 22 reported dead so far in one of the most volatile parts of the country.

item.title: Myanmar junta chief Min Aung Hlaing nominated as president
item.summary: The military leader, who has been sanctioned by Western countries, is now certain to get the job.

item.title: Fugitive Dezi Freeman shot dead by Australian police after seven months in hiding
item.summary: Freeman has been wanted since the fatal shooting of two police officers in Porepunkah in August.

item.title: Three killed as unfinished building collapses on church service in Ghana
item.summary: Locals say the structure, in a school complex, was in use despite lying unfinished for a number of years.
